Tempo Witness is a platform for user’s generated content that focus on community empowerment, using citizen journalism methodology. Users have to be trained by experienced journalists before accessing the platform. The training includes basic journalism techniques and information broker skills, to enable user to identify and report newsworthy information from their community. The outcome will be published on Tempo’s website and other news outlets.
